cropId.description: Lowercase snake_case crop id. Must exist in CropRules.crops[].id.

criterion.description: Scoring criteria. The same names are used for farmer priorities (weights) and for evaluation scores.

sourceRef.description: Id of a source listed in CropRules.sources or FieldData.sources.

climate.description: historical = recent observed years (NASA POWER). ssp* = NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 deltas applied to the observed years.

horizon.description: Target period mid-year for ssp scenarios.

rain_change_pct.description: Manual what-if slider applied on top of the scenario.

temp_change_c.description: Manual what-if slider applied on top of the scenario.
